title: Looking Up
alt: A black-and-white woodpecker clinging to a tree trunk on the right, head tilted up, framed by dark branches and soft green leaves.

title: Among the Berries
alt: The same woodpecker seen from behind on a branch, head turned to the left, among twigs hung with small dark berries against a pale sky.

title: Last Light
alt: A woodpecker on a dark, leaning trunk in dim evening light, almost lost among bare crossing branches.

title: In the Thicket
alt: A black-and-white woodpecker in profile on a slim trunk, looking up and to the left, with dark branches, hanging berries and soft leaves crowding the frame against a pale sky.

title: Rose
alt: A loose acrylic painting of a single pink-red rose with one leaf on a dark stem, against a swirling teal and deep blue sky with lilac clouds, a green hill at the bottom right.

title: Streetlight in fog
alt: A streetlight glowing through thick night fog with a soft rainbow ring around it, a line of smaller lights fading away below it and the dark shape of a tree on the right.

title: Figure in ink
detail: ink drawing, photographed on iPhone 15 Pro
alt: A loose black ink drawing of a figure lying on its side with closed eyes and wild, flowing hair, one arm reaching across the page, drawn in quick hatched strokes on cream paper.

title: Jasmine tea
alt: Looking down into a white bowl of steeped green tea leaves with a few white jasmine buds and small bubbles, a shaft of sunlight across the leaves.

title: Torn Halo
detail: snow sculpture by the Hôtel de Glace sculptors, Québec; iPhone 15 Pro, f/1.78, 1/105 s, ISO 200
alt: A carved snow relief of a young winged figure with curly hair looking upward, arms spread along huge feathered wings, all lit deep red.

title: Candlelight
alt: Hundreds of flameless pillar candles glowing amber on a dark floor, a few more hanging in the dark above

title: Daylily
alt: Two orange daylily blooms with yellow throats in sunlight against dark green leaves

title: Gaura and bumblebee
detail: Munich; iPhone 15 Pro, f/1.8, 1/952 s, ISO 80
alt: A bumblebee on pink gaura flowers in a street planter, an office building and a blue van blurred behind

title: Leaf miner
alt: A green leaf traced with pale winding tunnels left by a leaf-mining larva, a dark dead patch near its edge

title: Passetto di Borgo
detail: Rome; iPhone 15 Pro, f/1.8, 1/5814 s, ISO 80
alt: A crenellated stone wall over a row of brick arches, running diagonally against a clear blue sky, a carved papal coat of arms set into it

title: Safety first
detail: St. John's harbour; iPhone 13 Pro, f/2.8, 1/60 s, ISO 800
alt: The yellow bridge of a ship at dusk, amber lights glowing on its roof and SAFETY FIRST NO SMOKING painted in red, a black iron fence in front

title: Eye of gears
detail: snow sculpture by the Hôtel de Glace sculptors, Québec; iPhone 15 Pro, f/1.8, 1/118 s, ISO 80
alt: A snow sculpture of an eye in violet light, its iris a blue-lit gear around a spiral of blades and a dark pupil

title: Reaching hand
detail: snow sculpture by the Hôtel de Glace sculptors, Québec; iPhone 15 Pro, f/1.8, 1/118 s, ISO 125
alt: A snow sculpture of a reaching hand in relief, lit violet with pink at its edges

title: St. Peter's colonnade
detail: Vatican City; iPhone 15 Pro, f/1.8, 1/4310 s, ISO 80
alt: The curved colonnade of St. Peter's Square, rows of tall stone columns with statues of saints along the roofline against a blue sky

title: Tour Saint-Jacques
detail: Paris; iPhone 15 Pro, f/1.8, 1/5348 s, ISO 80
alt: The carved Gothic bell tower of Tour Saint-Jacques under heavy grey cloud, framed by treetops and willow branches

title: A Fine Bottle Indeed
alt: A pencil drawing of a sports-drink bottle seen from the cap down, its logo shaded in block letters, handwritten musings about its price down the left side and small squares of texture practice (bubbles, scales, cross-hatching) along the right.

title: Green Flames
detail: drag car at a car show
alt: A glossy green drag car painted with yellow and orange flames edged in purple, its supercharger and three carbon-fibre intake scoops rising out of the hood, in front of black curtains.

title: You Are What You Choose to Be
detail: pencil, fan drawing after The Iron Giant (1999)
alt: A pencil drawing of the Iron Giant's round robot head seen from the front, wide eyes and a fin down the middle, stars scattered to the right, with "You are what you choose to be" written around it.

title: Texture, Shading and Confidence
alt: A sketchbook page of pencil flowers: an outlined rosebud on a stem, two shaded open roses and four forget-me-nots, with "Texture, shading & confidence" written in the top corner.

title: Out on the Bike
alt: Zach, face hidden by a cap and hood, sitting on a white and blue dual-sport motorcycle on a gravel drive, trees and a shed behind.
